summary: Queue guidance distinguishes ordinary task repair from planning-invalidating Replan. Apply checks current execution authority, handoff arrangement and pending input before Ensure plan. Replan prepares candidates without overwriting accepted planning, then applies the approved map transactionally. Workspace queries remove repeated root resolution inside one call while retaining live identity, HEAD, configuration and dispatcher checks; regression coverage checks native-call cost and freshness. The explained double loop and both human handoff Gates remain in force, including exact-scope approval, pause/input recovery, terminal archive evidence and workspace/run interlocks.
